seriesTitle: Elite Short Stories: Guzmán Caye Rebe

episodes.title: Parte 1
episodes.summary: Rebe invites Cayetana and Guzmán over for some special cake at her brand new house. Shenanigans ensue.

episodes.title: Parte 2
episodes.summary: The three friends panic about what to do when they find a large stash of cocaine hidden in Rebe's house. Cayetana shares her upcoming job plans.

episodes.title: Parte 3
episodes.summary: Cayetana and Rebe argue with Guzmán over how to deal with the men trying to break into the house.
